title: Notion Shell — page/sidebar/database wrapper primitives
description: Portable Notion-style wrapper primitives: NotionPage (header + body shell), NotionHeader (icon + title), NotionSidebar (tree nav with full page CRUD), NotionBlock (single-block renderer dispatching via prop registry), NotionDatabase (table view + per-cell CRUD), NotionProperty (value + schema editor). Pure / props-driven — host owns data + change handlers. Drop into any React surface; pair with notion-blocks for the four editor primitives (equation, code, notify, grid). Lifted from notion-page-clone's shared/components/notion.
